outcome: Severity of white matter abnormality (WMA) on brain MRI at term-equivalent age
cohort: 33 preterm infants born at less than 32 weeks of gestation who underwent surgery due to either NEC or SIP
finding: Preterm infants with surgNEC exhibit more severe white matter injury (WMI) than those with SIP, as evidenced by brain MRI at term-equivalent age.
